items.title: Wonder Shops Grubhub to Walmart and Other Potential Buyers
items.why: A retail buyer could fold delivery perks into its loyalty program, which would reshape the delivery partners card benefits rely on.
items.summary_ai: Wonder is reportedly exploring a sale of Grubhub, with bankers approaching Walmart, Target, Kroger and other retailers.
items.take: A retail buyer could fold delivery perks into its loyalty program, which would reshape the delivery partners card benefits rely on.

items.title: Capital One Offers: 18% Back at CVS & 10% Back at Walgreens & Kroger
items.why: Merchant-specific card offers show issuers chasing everyday retail spend, though these are not premium-tier benefits.
items.summary_ai: Capital One Offers give 18% back at CVS and 10% back at Walgreens on in-store purchases, possibly including gift cards.
items.take: Merchant-specific card offers show issuers chasing everyday retail spend, though these are not premium-tier benefits.
